member.summary: Authentication and User Management Controller Handles user authentication, registration, profile management, and account control

member.name: M:ACM.Backend.Controllers.AuthController.Login(ACM.Backend.Core.DTOs.Member1.AuthRequestDto)
member.summary: User Login - Authenticate with email and password
member.remarks:
Authenticates a user with their email and password. Returns access token (10 min expiry) and refresh token (7 day expiry). No authorization required.
Sample request: POST /api/auth/login { "email": "user@acm.edu", "password": "Password123!" }
member.returns: AuthResponse with tokens and user info if successful, error message if failed
member.response: Authentication successful, returns access token and refresh token
Bad request - missing or invalid data

member.name: M:ACM.Backend.Controllers.AuthController.RefreshToken(ACM.Backend.Controllers.RefreshTokenRequestDto)
member.summary: Refresh Access Token - Get new access token using refresh token
member.remarks:
Issues a new access token using a valid refresh token. Implements token rotation - old refresh token is revoked and new one is issued. No authorization required.
Sample request: POST /api/auth/refresh { "refreshToken": "base64encodedtoken..." }
member.returns: New access token and refresh token

member.name: M:ACM.Backend.Controllers.AuthController.Register(ACM.Backend.Core.DTOs.Member1.RegisterUserDto)
member.summary: Register New User - Create a new user account
member.remarks:
Creates a new user account with specified role. Only DepartmentHead users can register new users. If role is Student, an AgentPersonality profile is automatically created. Requires valid JWT access token.
Sample request: POST /api/auth/register { "email": "newuser@acm.edu", "firstName": "John", "lastName": "Doe", "password": "Password123!", "role": "Student" }
member.response: Invalid input or email already exists

member.name: M:ACM.Backend.Controllers.AuthController.GetUserById(System.Guid)
member.summary: Get User by ID - Retrieve user details by ID
member.remarks:
Retrieves full user information including email, name, role, and status. Users can only retrieve their own record; DepartmentHead can retrieve anyone's.
Sample request: GET /api/auth/1
member.response: Forbidden - can only view your own record

member.name: M:ACM.Backend.Controllers.AuthController.GetUserByEmail(System.String)
member.summary: Get User by Email - Search user by email address
member.remarks:
Searches for a user by their email address. Users can only look up their own record by email; DepartmentHead can look up anyone.
Sample request: GET /api/auth/email/user@acm.edu
member.response: Forbidden - can only view your own record

member.remarks:
Returns a list of all users in the system. Only accessible to DepartmentHead (system administrators).

member.name: M:ACM.Backend.Controllers.AuthController.UpdateUser(System.Guid,ACM.Backend.Controllers.UpdateUserDto)
member.summary: Update User Profile - Modify user's first and last name
member.remarks:
Updates a user's first and last name. Users can only update their own profile, except DepartmentHead can update any user.
Sample request: PUT /api/auth/1 { "firstName": "Jonathan", "lastName": "Smith" }
member.response: Forbidden - can only update own profile

member.name: M:ACM.Backend.Controllers.AuthController.ChangePassword(System.Guid,ACM.Backend.Controllers.ChangePasswordDto)
member.remarks:
Allows a user to change their password. Users can only change their own password. Requires current password for verification.
Sample request: POST /api/auth/1/change-password { "currentPassword": "OldPass123!", "newPassword": "NewPass456!" }
member.response: Forbidden - can only change own password

member.name: M:ACM.Backend.Controllers.AuthController.DeactivateUser(System.Guid)
member.remarks:
Deactivates a user account (soft delete). Deactivated users cannot login but their data is preserved. Only DepartmentHead can deactivate users.
Sample request: POST /api/auth/1/deactivate
member.response: User does not have DepartmentHead role

member.name: M:ACM.Backend.Controllers.AuthController.ActivateUser(System.Guid)
member.summary: Activate User - Enable deactivated user account
member.remarks:
Reactivates a previously deactivated user account. Activated users can login again. Only DepartmentHead can activate users.
Sample request: POST /api/auth/1/activate
member.response: User does not have DepartmentHead role

member.name: M:ACM.Backend.Controllers.AuthController.Logout(ACM.Backend.Controllers.LogoutRequestDto)
member.summary: Logout - Revoke refresh token and logout user
member.remarks:
Logs out a user by revoking their refresh token. After logout, refresh token cannot be used to get new access tokens. Users must login again to get new tokens.
Sample request: POST /api/auth/logout { "refreshToken": "base64token..." }
